description: A needs-silence tool (Neon wired directly in infra) whose keepalive probe, or whose compose healthcheck, targets the store-querying readiness route /health must be flagged by `greenlight doctor` (DR-21, vision 07 §4.2); the same tool probing /health/live (C2) must not be. Fails on the doctor of 0.10.1, which has no DR-21.
